figure_2_b_c.software_or_process: manual coordinate reading from the paper's vector PDF and the PMC Figure 2 source image
figure_2_b_c.uncertainty: visible error bars were not digitized; uncertainty fields are null
figure_2_b_c.scope: Hs746T and NIH3T3/TPR only; KP-4 panel was not extracted because two experiments and overlapping series make one unambiguous series unavailable from this figure alone.

figure_2_a.software_or_process: manual coordinate reading from the vector PDF
figure_2_a.values: observed mean tumor-volume markers; Exp1 and Exp2 remain separate
figure_2_a.uncertainty: error bars overlap at several dose/time combinations and were not defensibly separable

figure_2_d.software_or_process: manual coordinate reading from the vector PDF
figure_2_d.uncertainty: visible SEM bars digitized approximately; these are not source-tabulated errors

figure_4.software_or_process: manual coordinate reading from the vector PDF
figure_4.values: 13 plotted clinical biopsy markers; tumour type and dose labels are retained where visible
figure_4.uncertainty: not reported per marker; on-treatment biopsy time is not specified in this paper

source_quantitative_summaries.scope: Supplement Table S1/S2 and main Table 1/2 values retained separately because they are published model estimates/results, not experimental observations.

normalization.tumor_volume: reported/digitized absolute tumor volume in mm3; no rescaling was applied
normalization.pMET: the supplement defines pMET as Y1234-1235 signal normalized to total MET, total protein, and paired baseline; no individual Figure 4 values were registered because the on-treatment biopsy time and patient-level biological contexts are not reported in this paper.

limitations: No raw individual-animal values or machine-readable source tables were provided.
The linked supplement exposes parameter estimates and methods, but not individual PK/PD records.
Figure 2 digitization is suitable for semi-quantitative in-vivo validation, not direct signaling-parameter fitting.
